{{Quote|The Life Day orb is a traditional part of our celebration. It shows a field of stars representing the afterlife. We beings of Kashyyyk believe that when we die that we walk off into the stars.|translated=1|Tebeurra|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Life Day Orbs''' were [[Glass/Legends|glass-like]], shining orbs used in the celebrations of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] holiday. The globes had a variety of uses during the festivities. Small ones were [[Color/Legends|colored]] and attached to the branches of [[Life Day tree/Legends|ornamented trees]], while others were kept as memorabilia. Most importantly, Wookiee households displayed such orbs on their tables and gathered around them before joining a silent [[Prayer/Legends|prayer]] ceremony.

==Description==
Life Day orbs were [[Glass/Legends|glass-like]] globes, typically clear,<ref name="SWHS" /> or with a glowing blue hue, and containing a field of [[Star/Legends|stars]] representing the [[Netherworld of the Force/Legends|afterlife]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> However, other Life Day orbs came in a variety of different [[Color/Legends|colors]], such as green, red, and yellow. Unlike the more traditional, [[Crystal/Legends|crystalline]] orbs, these brightly colored ornaments were used as festive [[Lamp/Legends|lamps]]. While these ornamented orbs glowed and sparkled, they lacked the field of stars seen in their more symbolic counterparts.<ref name="CWA">{{TCWA|loc=Main Hall}} {{C|"Life Day" festival, 2010&ndash;2013}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:FamilyBonds.jpg|180px|thumb|Chewbacca's family holding Life Day orbs in ''Family Bonds'']]
The origins of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] lay in the culture of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]],<ref name="CWABlog">{{WebCite|url=http://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1126|text=Life Day Returns!|work=the official [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']] website|archivedate=20111208024549|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]]<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> who hailed from the [[Tree/Legends|arboreal]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="EGTAS" /> with evidence that Wookiees celebrated the holiday by beating [[Tree-drum music|tree drums]] as early as [[1,500,000 BBY]].<ref name="Slugthrowers">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> Life Day orbs, a Wookiee artifact, were a traditional symbol carried by Wookiees during the Life Day celebrations. The glass-like, shining orbs constituted one of the holiday's most ancient of traditions, as evidenced by its portrayal in a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] titled ''[[Ancient Life Day]]'', in which it was seen being carried like a [[Lantern/Legends|lantern]] by a Wookiee reveler. The orbs typically contained a field of stars representing the afterlife. The beings of Kashyyyk believed that when when they [[Death/Legends|died]], they would walk off into the stars.<ref name="SWG" /> The globes had a variety of uses during Life Day festivities; small ones were colored and attached to the branches of [[Life Day tree/Legends|ornamented trees]], or hung from the ceiling,<ref name="CWA" /> while others were kept as memorabilia.<ref name="SWG" /> Most importantly, Wookiee households displayed such orbs on their tables and gathered around them before joining a silent [[Prayer/Legends|prayer]] ceremony.<ref name="SWHS" /> Over [[Time/Legends|time]], the tradition of putting up colorful decorations, like Life Day orbs, had spread to other parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CWABlog">{{WebCite|url=http://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1126|text=Life Day Returns!|work=the official [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Clone Wars Adventures'']] website|archivedate=20111208024549|nolive=1}}</ref> By the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> around [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="DateTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> other [[Species/Legends|species]] and cultures carried Life Day orbs as part of the holiday tradition. A jolly old man known as the "[[Master of Ceremonies]]," accompanied by a group of [[Life Day Revelers]], sold Life Day orbs aboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Carrick Station]], and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] [[Vaiken Spacedock]], in exchange for gift parcels.<ref name="SWTOR" />

Later, during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the hallowed halls of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] were decorated with colored Life Day orbs during their Life Day festivities.<ref name="CWA" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Life Day had become increasingly important to the Wookiees since the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] many of their kind.<ref name="Holiday">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Happy%20Holidays%202003|text=Happy Holidays 2003}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], along with his friends, [[Chewbacca's family/Legends|family]], and many other Wookiees, carried Life Day orbs during the [[Tree of Life/Legends|Tree of Life]] ceremony on Kashyyyk. Afterwards, Chewbacca participated in a more intimate ceremony with his family, by gathering in silent prayer around a number of Life Day orbs placed on a table in their [[Chewbacca's home|home]].<ref name="SWHS" /> During other Life Day festivities around this time, [[Oraalarri]] the Elder and his family, comprising of [[Anarra]], [[Radrrl]], and [[Tebeurra]], imparted gifts of Life Day orbs to revelers who visited their camps on the [[Forest/Legends|Forest]] [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], and [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. As a culturally significant aspect of the Wookiee holiday, Life Day orbs were featured prominently in several artworks, namely paintings, such as the aforementioned ''Ancient Life Day'', as well as ''[[Family Bonds]]'', which depicted Chewbacca's family proudly holding a collection of Life Day orbs. Yet another [[Gift Giving Wookiees|painting]] depicted two young Wookiee [[Pup (Wookiee)|pups]] presenting Life Day orbs to one another.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LifeDayOrbDIY.jpg|200px|thumb|DIY Life Day orbs from StarWars.com]]
Life Day orbs made their first appearance in the television film ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'',<ref name="SWHS" /> which aired on [[November 17]], [[1978]].<ref name="Boba Fett: Mystery Man">{{GalaxyCite|1|Boba Fett: Mystery Man in Not-So-Shining Armor}}</ref> In the script for the film, the glowing orbs are not given a specific name, and are simply referred to as "globes."<ref name="Vault">''[[The Star Wars Vault]]''</ref> The globes were first identified as Life Day orbs when they were introduced to the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing games]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Capitalization of the name, however, was somewhat inconsistent. The description for the item fully capitalized it as a "Life Day Orb," whereas discussions with the Wookiee Tebeurra consistently referred to the object as a "Life Day orb." This article assumes the latter form to be correct.<ref name="SWG" /> In a [[December 19]], 2003 feature titled "Happy Holidays 2003," the developers encouraged players to celebrate Life Day during the months of December and early January. For their part, the developers began dropping numerous Wookiee Life Day orbs and [[Life Day robes/Legends|robes]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] halls of player cities that were registered on the planetary map. The developers intended for the [[Mayor/Legends|mayors]] of such cities to share the items with their residents. In addition to letting mayors hand out the items, the developers began attending various live events, and handed out orbs to players and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] to give away or sell. They continued to hand out orbs and [[Robe/Legends|robes]] throughout the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of December and into January, and ensured that the items did not become exceedingly rare.<ref name="Holiday" /> With the release of Publish 11.5 on [[December 14]], [[2004]],<ref name="Publish2004">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64187&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2004}}</ref> players could receive a Life Day orb from the Wookiee elder Oraalarri, during that [[Standard year/Legends|year's]] Life Day event.<ref name="SWG" /> On [[December 22]], the developers also added a new a level-up item called "An Energetic Lifeday Orb." This item could be looted from various NPCs and creatures, and used in order to grant the player an additional experience level.<ref name="Publish2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> On [[January 4]], [[2006]], the celebrations were concluded as part of Publish 26.6, and the Life Day orbs could no longer be obtained.<ref name="Publish2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref> During the Life Day event which premiered on [[December 12]], [[2007]], players who interacted with one of the large [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] would receive two gift boxes, one of which would contain a Hanging Life Day Orb.<ref name="Celebrate">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67531&month=122007|text=Friday Feature &ndash; Celebrating Life Day}}</ref>

Sony Online Entertainment was also responsible for the production of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' video game]], yet another MMORPG which featured Life Day orbs during their celebratory events.<ref name="CWA" /> During the [[December 17]], [[2010]] update, [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic Credits]] could be earned by clicking on "Republic Credit Orbs" which appeared randomly throughout the Jedi Temple.<ref name="CWAOrbUpdate">{{SonyForumsCite|url=cw/posts/list.m?topic_id=1877|text=Server Maintenance for December 17, 2010}}</ref> Credits could in turn be spent on various Life Day-themed items, including a Life Day Decorations Pack which contained various Life Day orbs.<ref name="PackI">{{TCWA|set=Life Day Decorations Pack I}}</ref> Life Day orbs were similarly featured during the game's subsequent Life Day events,<ref name="CWA" /> up until the game's closure in [[2014]].<ref name="CWAClosure">{{WebCite|url=https://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1589|text=With Heavy Hearts, We Announce the Sunset of Clone Wars|author=George, Steve|date=2014-01-24|archivedate=20140127193845}}</ref> Life Day is also featured in the 2011 MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', produced and released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> As part of Game Update 1.6: Ancient Hypergate released on [[December 11]], [[2012]], Life Day orbs were made available for sale on the Cartel Market, an in-game microtransaction store in which players exchange Cartel Coins for various in-game merchandise.<ref name="SWTOR12">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.6.0/ancient-hypergate|text=Game Update 1.6: Ancient Hypergate Patch Notes}}</ref> Starting with the [[2015]] festivities released as part of Game Update 4.0.3 on December 15,<ref name="SWTOR15">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1272015/game-update-4.0.3|text=Game Update 4.0.3}}</ref>, Life Day orbs, which were originally sold on the Cartel Market, were now sold by the Master of Ceremonies in exchange for gift parcels. However, a new item was made available on the Cartel Market, which spawns a small Life Day orb that follows the player around.<ref name="SWTOR" />

Two [[StarWars.com]] blog posts describe how to make homemade Life Day orbs for a Life Day-inspired real world celebration. One blog post, titled "DIY Wookiee Life Day Wreaths," describes how to make a [[Life Day Wreath]] affixed with a Life Day orb, using an ornament filled with blue ribbon.<ref name="DIY">{{SW|url=news/diy-wookiee-life-day-wreaths|text=DIY Wookiee Life Day Wreaths}}</ref> Another blog post, titled "How to Host a Life Day Celebration," describes how to make Life Day orbs using [[Plastic/Legends|plastic]] snow globes, flameless [[Tea/Legends|tea]] lights, and rhinestone stickers.<ref name="Host">{{SW|url=news/how-to-host-a-life-day-celebration|text=How to Host a Life Day Celebration}}</ref>
